UX Update

5. Adding hinting feature.
6. Adding a mysterious new level.

notes.title: Level 3 Bug Fixes And Updates!
notes.notes:
In this update, we are focusing on improving the level 3!
Updates and Fixes:
1. Fixed the issue where the "stationery pieces" would stack with each other.
2. Fixed multiple logical mistakes in level 3.
3. Fixed the issue where when "you" are in the storage room and "I" am in the warehouse, there is no way to progress further.
4. Added the option to push the save back to the dining room.
5. Fixed the issue where the "needle" card would blink when pulling it out of the stationery case.
6. Added a new hint to the usage of the save.
7. The lines that the characters speak when moving from place to place are now more accurate and helpful.
8. Added the "this is too hard" cheat button to the stationery case puzzle.
9. Added the reset button to the stationery case puzzle.

Hello, Prison of Word only supports Chinese at the moment, thank you for reading this English version of Update log!
